message: Operator clarification: preserve the canonical Jarvis project URL even if the ChatGPT root URL happens to make conversation-URL capture more reliable. Capturing the server-issued conversation URL is NOT required for normal agent operations; do not treat it as a launch prerequisite or recommend weakening project context/routing merely to improve that optional observation. Audit the separation between (a) successful prompt submission/recipient activation and (b) optional conversation URL discovery. Determine whether ConversationUrlUnavailable incorrectly turns an otherwise successful launch into an overall failure/OutcomeUnknown, whether route capture is only needed for a specific later capability, and whether the caller can proceed safely without it. Keep project URL as the launch destination. Record exact evidence and do not retry the already-sent test prompt.
